basics.title: Senior Front-End Engineer
basics.summary: Senior front-end engineer with four years building production interfaces for enterprise and government clients, now focused on putting AI-assisted development to work inside real team workflows. Shipped an accessibility toolkit saving over SAR 500,000 a year and cut ticket turnaround from one week to 1.5 days through custom agent tooling. Deep in React and TypeScript; fast on new stacks — picked up Flutter and shipped team features within a week.

roles.title: Senior Front-End Engineer
highlights: Built an accessibility compliance toolkit adopted across departmental domains, cutting remediation cost by SAR 70,000 per domain — over SAR 500,000 in annual savings. Delivered in one week using AI-assisted development.

Established AI-assisted development practice for the front-end team: authored custom agent skills that automate repetitive implementation work and integrated MCP servers into the development workflow, cutting ticket turnaround from one week to roughly 1.5 days.
Designed an executive dashboard visualizing cybersecurity events across Saudi Arabia, rendering a live timeline of 300+ events per minute for leadership.
Built a dynamic form builder reused across multiple front-end projects, supporting varied input types, validation rules, and conditional logic — removing repeated form work from every new build.
Developed a cross-platform mobile application in Flutter with reusable components and clean architecture, shipping production features within the first week of picking up Dart.
Expanded automation across build, testing, and deployment, and led internal technical discussions that aligned the team on front-end standards.

roles.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Built pages, components, and internal tools for client projects in React and Ant Design.
Developed interactive dashboards with Apache ECharts surfacing insights from user behavior data.
Wrote end-to-end automated tests covering critical user flows.
Acted as the front-end voice in project scoping and technical planning.

roles.title: Software Developer Intern
highlights: Implemented bug fixes and enhancements to user dashboards and mobile apps.
Tested web and mobile features, creating tickets for improvements.
Reviewed production code to maintain quality standards.

projects.name: Saudi Trails
projects.description: A bilingual (Arabic-first) map of hiking trails across Saudi Arabia, bringing together the King Salman Royal Reserve and the Darb association. Search and filter 39 trails by source, region and difficulty, and see their full routes on satellite or terrain maps. Darb trails refresh weekly at build time from its public data; every trail is credited and linked to its official page.

site.tagline: I build things for the web.
site.intro: Senior Front-End Engineer specializing in **React** and **TypeScript**. I build intuitive interfaces, reusable component systems, and AI-assisted development workflows — currently at **SITE**.
about: I'm a Senior Front-End Engineer based in Saudi Arabia with {years} years of professional experience building web applications and developer tooling. I specialize in **React** and **TypeScript**, with a strong focus on reusable component systems, interactive data dashboards, and putting AI-assisted development to work for the engineering teams I work with.

I studied Computer Science — with a minor in Space! — at the **University of Colorado Boulder**, graduating in 2022. I made the Dean's List twice and built a foundation in software engineering that I've carried into every role since.
Outside of code, I enjoy cooking, tabletop games, camping, hiking, astronomy, and storytelling.
